<?php

...
    private function writePlotGroup(?DataSeries $plotGroup, $groupType, XMLWriter $objWriter, &$catIsMultiLevelSeries, &$valIsMultiLevelSeries, &$plotGroupingType): void
    {
...
            //    Formatting for the points
            if   (($groupType == DataSeries::TYPE_LINECHART) || ($groupType == DataSeries::TYPE_STOCKCHART))
            {
...
            }

            // suppress lines connecting markers
            if (!$plotSeriesValues->isLine() && $groupType == DataSeries::TYPE_SCATTERCHART)
            {
...
            }

            // specify marker type, size & color 
            $fill = $border = $fillColorType = $borderColorType = 0;
            if ($plotSeriesValues) 
            {
                $plotSeriesMarker = $plotSeriesValues->getPointMarker();
                if ($plotSeriesMarker) 
                {
                    $objWriter->startElement('c:marker');
                    $objWriter->startElement('c:symbol');
                    $objWriter->writeAttribute('val', $plotSeriesMarker);
                    $objWriter->endElement();
 
                    /* added as suggested by Github user GajowyJ */
                    if ($plotSeriesMarker !== 'none') 
                    {
                        $objWriter->startElement('c:size');
                        $objWriter->writeAttribute('val', $plotSeriesValues->getPointSize());
                        $objWriter->endElement();
                    }
 
                    /* as suggested by Github user GajowyJ */
                    // marker (point) fill | [fill border] color 
                    $fillColor = $plotSeriesValues->getFillColor();
                    if (!is_null($fillColor) ) 
                    {
                        if (is_array($fillColor))
                        {
                            $fill   = array_shift($fillColor);
                            $border = array_shift($fillColor);
                            if (is_int($fill))
                            {
                                $fillColorType    = 'srgbClr' ;
                                // excel expects 6 character hex color; dechex suppresses leading zeroes
                                $fill = sprintf("%'06X",$fill); // excel expects 6 character hex value
                            }
                            else 
                            {
                                $fillColorType    = 'schemeClr';
                            }
                            if (is_int($border))
                            {
                                $borderColorType = 'srgbClr' ;
                                $border = sprintf("%'06X",$border);
                            }
                            else 
                            {
                                $borderColorType = 'schemeClr';
                            }
                        }
                        else // if not array, $fillColor is border color
                        {
                            $border = $fillColor;
                            $borderColorType    = is_int($border) ? 'srgbClr' : 'schemeClr';
                        }
                        $objWriter->startElement('c:spPr');
                        if ($fill) 
                        {
                            $objWriter->startElement('a:solidFill');
                            $objWriter->startElement('a:' . $fillColorType);
                            $objWriter->writeAttribute('val',$fill);
                            $objWriter->endElement();  // a:xxxxClr
                            $objWriter->endElement();  // a:solidFill
                        }
                        if ($border) 
                        {
                            $objWriter->startElement('a:ln');
                            $objWriter->startElement('a:solidFill');
                            $objWriter->startElement('a:' . $borderColorType);
                            $objWriter->writeAttribute('val',$border);
                            $objWriter->endElement();  // a:xxxxClr
                            $objWriter->endElement();  // a:solidFill
                            $objWriter->endElement();  // a:ln
                        }
                        $objWriter->endElement();  // c:spPr
                    }
                    $objWriter->endElement(); // marker
                }
            }
